source.dashboard: Tec Visual Vocabulary > Visual Vocabulary > Deviation
source.how: REST definition + instance JSON (setCurrentPanel on a guest instance; dashboard-level epm colors from getServerJSONResults), nothing saved

techniques.colorBySign: Put the value metric on ColorBy as well, then add two value thresholds on it: below the breakpoint fill #f8942c (orange), at/above it fill #035397 (blue). Stored per template as thresholds[metricId] = [{fmt:{bc}, ttp:7, flr:-Infinity, ceil:X}, {fmt:{bc}, flr:X, ceil:Infinity}]; visProp.fmt.th = 1.
techniques.customOrigin: visProp.fmt.axisOrigin = { <metricId>: { axOriAuto:false, axOriValue:0.2 } } moves the zero line to a reference value (bars grow left/right of 20%).
techniques.negatedMetric: Tornado: a metric that is the negative of last year's value plots to the left; its number format "$"#,##0;"$"#,##0 hides the minus sign.
techniques.elementColors: Diverging stacked bar: Response elements colored at dashboard level (epm, emt 1): Very Dissatisfied #f8942c, Dissatisfied #f9b167, Satisfied #3e6d95, Very Satisfied #035397. Negative responses carry negative values so they stack left of 0.
techniques.metricColors: Tornado: dashboard-level metric colors (epm, emt 2): Last Year's Revenue Negative #f89427, This Year's Revenue #035397.

examples.title: Diverging Bar Chart (Horizontal)
examples.visualCues: horizontal bars sorted high to low, blue bars right of a reference line, orange bars left of it; the reference line is not at 0

examples.title: Diverging Stacked Bar Chart
examples.visualCues: one horizontal bar per year split into four segments; two orange shades left of 0, two blue shades right; axis in percent with negatives in parentheses

XAxis: % of Respondents Absolute (negative for dissatisfied responses)

settings.elementColors: Very Dissatisfied #f8942c, Dissatisfied #f9b167, Satisfied #3e6d95, Very Satisfied #035397

examples.title: Tornado (Butterfly) Chart
examples.visualCues: two bar series back to back from a center line, orange left and blue right, sorted largest to smallest, both axes show positive dollars

settings.metricColors: Last Year's Revenue Negative #f89427, This Year's Revenue #035397

examples.title: Diverging Bar Chart (Vertical)
examples.visualCues: vertical bars over time, blue above 0, orange below

examples.title: Stacked Area Chart
examples.visualCues: a filled area over time, blue above 0 and orange below, with a gradient where it crosses zero

settings.thresholds: same as the vertical diverging bar

commonFormatting.colors: orange #f8942c = below target / negative, blue #035397 = above / positive
commonFormatting.legend: LegendVisibleness Show, small swatches on the right
commonFormatting.page: free-form, light blue-gray background, heading DEVIATION in orange, a title + one-line description above each chart

helpers.metricThresholds(vizKey, metricId, bands: Thresholds dialog with 'Value' basis: act threshold, thresholdType 7, objType 4, bands [{fmt:{FormattingPatterns:{FillColor:bgr,FillStyle:0}}, flr, ceil}]. Fills chart marks when the metric is also on Color By.
helpers.elementColors(attrId, {value: hex}): Shape Fill Color on an element: dashboard-level updateElementsPropertiesMap, epmk ob {did: attrId, tp 12}, chn [{emt 1, ei 'h<value>;<attrId>', at {did, tp 12, ql 0}}], vv {color: bgr}
helpers.metricColors({metricId: hex}): dashboard-level metric colors (emt 2), used wherever a chart colors by Metric Names
helpers.chartFormat(vizKey, vis, {axisOrigin: {m: writes Shape/Subtype/visType for a chart inserted in this session; axisOrigin is stored as {'@pLd<id>':{axOriAuto:false, axOriValue:'0.33'}, 'AllMetrics':{...}} and needs xAxOriLnShw/yAxOriLnShw 'true' or viewing ignores it

buildFromCode.signedSegments: derived metric If(([Claim Status]@ID = "Denied") Or ([Claim Status]@ID = "In Litigation"), -1, 1) * [Claim Count] gives negative values for the 'bad' elements (verified: Denied (380), In Litigation (210)). ApplySimple was rejected.
buildFromCode.tornado: Metric Names on BOTH Columns and Color By puts the two metrics in side-by-side panels (back to back). Color By alone stacks them in two row panels.
buildFromCode.verified: 2026-11-10 on Shared Studio › Business Insurance Claims Analytics: 'zz Deviation Showcase v2' (My Reports) built in 6.8 s: Paid to Reserve by Policy Type around 33%, signed Claim Status segments by Region, Reserve (left) vs Payment Amount by Policy Type, and Surplus/Deficit (2,800,000 - Payment Amount) by month as bars and area. The axis-origin flags were then added to the saved dashboard with the same props chartFormat now writes.
buildFromCode.notYet: Axis labels on the tornado's left panel still show negative numbers ($-70M); the demo hides the sign in the axis too.
